title: Appoint and annually review Internal Ombudsman strength
objective: Ensure the IO office is staffed per the RBI scheme
activity: Appoint at least one IO and have the CSC review IO strength at least once a year
testing_procedure: Inspect latest CSC minutes and appointment file

title: Report IO vacancies to RBI within deadline
objective: Ensure RBI is informed of IO vacancies on time
activity: On any IO vacancy inform RBI within 10 working days with dispatch proof
expected_evidence: RBI intimation letter with dispatch proof
testing_procedure: Trace vacancy events to dispatch records

title: Escalate rejected complaints to the IO
objective: Ensure no rejected complaint bypasses the IO
activity: Escalate every rejected or partly redressed complaint to the IO before final communication
testing_procedure: Re-perform a sample of 25 escalated complaints

title: Retain IO records for five years
objective: Preserve IO records for the required retention period
activity: Retain IO-related records for at least 5 years from final disposal

title: Quarterly IO report to the Board CSC
objective: Keep the Board informed of IO functioning
activity: Submit a quarterly IO report to the CSC covering reviews and systemic issues
expected_evidence: Quarterly IO report acknowledged by CSC

title: Staff awareness training on the IO scheme
